dedupe_keys.name: great lakes white nile basin soundings and bathymetry

description: Hamilton and colleagues publish lake soundings and bathymetry for the Great Lakes of the White Nile basin in Harvard Dataverse. The own DOI repository is CC0 1.0 and makes sounding tables, zipped point data and compressed bathymetric rasters available for four lakes. The data can set depth, storage and hydraulic geometry in lake or reservoir simulations supporting water-supply and flood studies. A caveat is that sounding coverage and interpolation error differ among lakes, so a raster cell should not be read as a directly surveyed depth without checking source points. The article's shoreline and elevation layers have separate Dataverse DOIs and should be paired using their stated coordinate references. I read the own licence, file manifest and article Data Records without downloading the archives, checking vertical datums or calculating water volumes. No directly related catalogue record was identified.
